nodes.label: db service (PostgreSQL + pgvector)
nodes.rationale: pgvector/pgvector:pg16 image — single Postgres serves relational + vector (RAG) data, avoiding a second datastore. Healthcheck-gated (pg_isready).

nodes.label: redis service (cache/queue)
nodes.rationale: redis:7-alpine for session cache, rate limiting, and APScheduler broker; healthcheck via redis-cli ping. Not yet exercised at runtime.

nodes.label: backend service (FastAPI)
nodes.rationale: FastAPI app built from ./backend, hot-reload via ./backend/app volume mount; ENABLE_BACKGROUND_JOBS=true. Starts only after db and redis report healthy.

hyperedges.label: Local dev stack (docker-compose: db + redis + backend)
